outcome: abnormal brain magnetic resonance image (MRI) findings
cohort: The study included 69 hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of a tertiary hospital.
finding: Decreased muscle tone and lower Apgar scores were significantly associated with abnormal brain MRI findings in HIE infants, with hypotonia and 1- and 5-minute Apgar scores below certain cut-offs increasing the risk of abnormal MRI results 7.23- to 9.78-fold.
